description: This Java class defines a dialog fragment for fingerprint authentication with fallback to password authentication in an Android application. It manages the UI and logic for fingerprint scanning, switching between fingerprint and password inputs, and handling user interactions related to biometric authentication.

classes.name: FingerprintAuthenticationDialogFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment handling fingerprint authentication with fallback to password, including UI management and interaction logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initial setup of the fragment, retaining instance and setting style.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates layout, initializes UI components, sets listeners, and manages fingerprint availability.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts fingerprint listening if in fingerprint stage.

methods.name: setStage
methods.description: Sets the current authentication stage (FINGERPRINT, PASSWORD, etc.).

methods.name: setCryptoObject
methods.description: Assigns cryptographic object for fingerprint authentication.

methods.name: checkPassword
methods.description: Placeholder method that always validates passwords for demo purposes.

methods.name: updateStage
methods.description: Updates UI based on current authentication stage.

methods.name: onEditorAction
methods.description: Handles keyboard actions for password input.

methods.name: onAuthenticated
methods.description: Callback when fingerprint is successfully authenticated.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles fingerprint errors and switches to password fallback.
